# Vendored source

This repository includes the source used by the plugin, not upstream Git history
or unrelated GUI/plugin applications.

- `ntsc-rs/crates/ntscrs`: unmodified ntsc-rs core at commit
  `8cfc51014092a6dc1da5eb0217bb9ae6516b124e`,
  from https://github.com/valadaptive/ntsc-rs.
  The workspace manifest is adapted to include only this core crate.
  MIT, ISC and Apache-2.0 license texts are preserved.
- `obs-studio/libobs`: OBS Studio 32.0.4 libobs source/headers at commit
  `dcdbd2e9048ae66237fdab32dbba72b745b1b9c5`,
  from https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio. Used for the C bridge headers;
  libobs itself is linked from the user's OBS installation.
  Upstream `COPYING` and bundled source notices are preserved.
- `cargo`: locked crates.io dependencies, generated by `cargo vendor --locked`.
  Cargo checksums and original package notices are preserved.

The full upstream OBS application is not included or built. Install OBS Studio
separately. See the upstream repositories for the rest of their applications.
